components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #990000; border-radius: 10px; background: #990000; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #7f0000; background: #7f0000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { border-color: #d4d0ce; background: #d4d0ce; color: #807b78; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #d8d4d1; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #1b1b1b; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #aaa39f; background: #faf9f8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: #4b4744; font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #d6d1ce; border-radius: 9px; background: #ffffff; color: #151515; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #aaa39f; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #990000; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.1); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Current section inside the black admin navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: #2a0c0c; color: #ffffff; font: 500 15px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #202020; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid #d22d2d; border-radius: 3px; background: #d22d2d; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Selectable service record with thumbnail, route, and state.
components.css: .ds-service-row { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #f4e9e9; color: #161616; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-service-row:hover { background: #f1e3e3; } .ds-service-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-service-thumb { width: 46px; height: 50px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #ded9d6; color: #6e6864; font: 500 16px/1 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-service-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-service-copy strong { overflow: hidden; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-service-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: #68615d; font: 400 11px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-published { min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e5f3e8; color: #245f31; font: 500 11px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Published Status
components.css: .ds-status-published { width: fit-content; min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e5f3e8; color: #245f31; font: 500 11px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Draft Status
components.css: .ds-status-draft { width: fit-content; min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eeeae7; color: #6d6661; font: 500 11px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Content Panel
components.html:
Service library

Select an item to update its public content.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dfdcda; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #151515; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-heading { padding: 22px 22px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ebe8e6; } .ds-panel-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-panel-heading p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #665f5b; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Image Upload Field
components.description: Card or detail image control with preview and file guidance.
components.html:
No image
Service card image

Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 5MB.
components.css: .ds-image-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 16px; border: 1px dashed #cfc9c5; border-radius: 12px; background: #faf9f8; color: #151515; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-image-preview { height: 108px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9px; background: #e7e2df; color: #7b7470; font-size: 12px; } .ds-image-field strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-image-field p { margin: 5px 0 13px; color: #665f5b; font-size: 12px; } .ds-upload-button { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #c8c2be; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #252321; font: 500 12px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload-button:hover { border-color: #aaa39f; background: #faf9f8; } .ds-upload-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Publish Switch
components.description: Binary publication control with an explicit public-site consequence.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #151515; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-switch-track { width: 42px; height: 24px; position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 999px; background: #c9c4c1; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-switch-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: #990000; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 3px solid rgba(153, 0, 0, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-switch-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-switch-copy strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-switch-copy small { color: #665f5b; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
The admin surface translates the IOU Finance brand into a calm operating environment: warm paper-like neutrals, black structural navigation, and a single deep-red action color. It should feel dependable and deliberate rather than promotional. Density is compact enough for frequent content work, while generous panel padding and a clear two-pane hierarchy keep the editor easy to scan.

Brand expression is concentrated in the logo, the Faculty Glyphic page title, and restrained red accents. Everything used to search, edit, order, publish, or delete content stays in Inter Tight and follows familiar application conventions. State must remain legible without relying on accent color alone.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral workspace with crisp white editing surfaces.
Black navigation structure with rare, deliberate IOU red accents.
Editorial display type only at brand and page-title moments.
Compact, familiar controls with explicit saved, draft, published, disabled, and destructive states.
Flat panels, fine borders, restrained motion, and shadow reserved for transient feedback.
A desktop sidebar that becomes persistent bottom navigation on narrow screens.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Brand red is an operational signal, not decoration; keep it rare enough that save, publish, focus, and active states remain unmistakable.

rules.name: The State Pair Rule
rules.body: Published and draft status always use both a filled pill and a text label, never color alone.

rules.name: The Brand-Moment Rule
rules.body: Faculty Glyphic is reserved for the page title and brand moments; all navigation, metrics, controls, fields, state labels, and editor copy use Inter Tight.

rules.name: The Medium-Weight Rule
rules.body: Operational emphasis uses weight 500; heavier display weights are not part of this surface.

rules.name: The Two-Pane Rule
rules.body: Keep selection context visible beside editing context whenever the viewport can support it; stack only when width would compromise field readability.

rules.name: The Mobile Dock Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, core navigation stays fixed at the bottom and the content always reserves safe space for it.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Persistent panels are border-defined and shadowless; elevation is reserved for transient feedback.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Larger containment earns larger rounding: 16px panels, 12px media fields, 8–10px controls, and pills only for status or binary state.

dos: Do preserve the black, white, warm-neutral, and deep-red hierarchy across new admin screens.
Do keep Faculty Glyphic to the page title or a genuine brand moment and use Inter Tight for all operational UI.
Do use familiar list, field, button, switch, and confirmation conventions for content-management tasks.
Do pair status color with explicit text and preserve high contrast for interactive states.
Do use 12–16px radii for meaningful surfaces and 8–10px radii for controls.
Do protect unsaved edits before selection changes or new-record creation, recover safely from invalid local records, and surface storage-limit or validation failures in plain language.
Do preserve the responsive progression from full sidebar to compact rail to fixed bottom navigation.
donts: Don't spread brand red across large backgrounds or use it as general decoration.
Don't use Faculty Glyphic for form labels, table rows, metrics, buttons, or dense editor copy.
Don't add persistent card shadows, glass effects, gradients, or ornamental motion to the working surface.
Don't communicate published, draft, disabled, selected, or destructive state through color alone.
Don't reduce primary touch targets below the implemented 42–44px control floor.
Don't introduce a new product promise or marketing claim into the admin design contract.
